quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (April 2025 - March 2026, annual securities report): consolidated revenue JPY 107,346 million (+9.7% YoY), operating profit JPY 10,885 million (+37.2%), profit before tax JPY 11,747 million (+46.8%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 8,661 million (+53.6%); operating margin 10.1%. quarterly_data.signal: Electronics and Motion Companies, FY2026: SANUPS (power systems) demand was robust for servers for data centers and information and communications, social infrastructure (fire, police) and defense systems, with stable renewable-energy demand and rising semiconductor-equipment demand; SANMOTION demand for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and wafer transfer robots increased significantly as AI-related capital investment got fully under way, and machine-tool demand recovered on active capex in China. quarterly_data.quarter: Sanyo Denki annual securities report: FY2026 (06-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management plan (annual securities report): the 10th Medium-Term Management Plan started in April 2026, running five years under the theme 'Time into strength', aiming to shorten time dramatically and make the company number one in product development, delivery and operational quality. Management indicators: free-cash-flow-focused management, ROE of 10% or more on a continuing basis (FY2026: 7.2%, up from 5.0%) and a focus on operating margin (FY2026: 10.1%). Under the 9th plan (FY2022 - FY2026) the group developed and launched 49 new products, opened a third technology center at its Taiwan subsidiary, started a stepping motor assembly plant at Sanyo Denki Europe, and brought Sanyo Denki Philippines' fourth factory into full operation from April 2024 to produce San Ace, SANUPS and SANMOTION products for communication equipment and semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
quarterly_data.figure: ROE target 10% or more (FY2026 7.2%); 49 new products under the 9th plan
